_about: Obligation Owners seed. 'rules' holds one Any/Any default rule: replace {{OWNER_EMAIL}} with the person (or shared mailbox user) who should own anything no more specific rule covers. 'examples' is NOT loaded by the deploy script; it shows how more specific rules look. Add your own in the Obligation Owners list. The most specific matching rule wins: counterparty, then category + business unit, then category, then business unit, then Any/Any.

examples._comment: Example: Finance owns every payment obligation, whatever the business unit. Messages by email only.
examples.Title: Finance - payments

examples._comment: Example: Legal owns every notice and renewal deadline. Messages by email and Teams.
examples.Title: Legal - notices and renewals
